status: CONFIRMATORY configuration of H17.10 (seeds 1 to 3, one gpu and one probe run per seed). Fixed on 2026-09-24 before any R4 output existed (build task; only a smoke with 2,000 images ran).
gpu_lock: shared for --stage gpu; none for data, probe, probe_tm, report

params.engine_note: masked mode, V 2000, every other field the EngineConfig default of docs/11 section 7 (T 64, s 128, l_slots 32, v_slots 64, budget 12, neg_mode binomial, seg_weighting recency, neg_budget 2, cand_tries 1, mask_rate 0.15); n_bag_k 3 because an image document has 56 tokens and bag buckets 3 to 12 cover distances above 64; epochs 4 as the R1 arms

probe.notes: labels drawn per class from the 50,000 pool images only (patch_tokens.stratified_sample, key (seed, budget, draw)); accuracy on the 10,000 dev images; LR on log(1 + count) rows with unit L2 norm for codes and bovw, standardised dense features for pixels; the supervised tmu Coalesced TM sees the binarised pixels of the same labelled sample

verdict.rule: H17.10 (docs/13 A7): at 10 labels per class, code_main (trained bank) minus the stronger of code_young (C0y) and bovw (bag of visual words per quadrant; stronger = higher mean over all (seed, draw) cells), LR probe, paired over (seed, draw), seeds 1 to 3 x 5 draws: mean >= 2.0 points AND the paired-bootstrap 95 percent interval (10,000 resamples) excludes 0
